outgoing.name: Arable land
outgoing.excerpt: The valley is an area of rich arable and dairy farmland, interspersed with a number of villages.

outgoing.name: Chestnut
outgoing.excerpt: Mature oak (Quercus) and ash (Fraxinus excelsior) trees are characteristic of the area with occasional groups of scots pine (Pinus sylvestris) and Chestnuts (Castanea sativa).

outgoing.name: Cricket
